GarmentCode is a Python framework for designing parametric sewing patterns. It provides a library (PyGarment) for defining garment components and their relationships, enabling the creation of customizable and adaptable clothing designs. The project also includes a dataset of 3D garments and a configurator GUI for interactive design.

EffectCraft is an open-source motion graphics and compositing tool written in Rust, aiming to be a clean-room reimplementation of Adobe After Effects. It offers features like Lottie import/export, scriptability, and a readable project file format, making it suitable for creating animated titles, motion graphics, and visual effects.

JARM is a Python-based tool for active Transport Layer Security (TLS) server fingerprinting. It generates unique fingerprints for TLS servers by analyzing their responses to a series of Client Hello packets, enabling verification of TLS configurations, grouping of servers by configuration, identification of default infrastructure, and detection of malicious command and control servers.
